# Mastervolt® Introduces Next-Generation Solutions to Power the Future of Connected Energy and Unveils New Brand Identity


[Download as PDF](https://www.brunswick.com/_assets/_730ae7666f38fa4de4aeceb499c746f4/brunswick/news/2026-11-17_Mastervolt_Introduces_Next_Generation_Solutions_1020.pdf) November 17, 2026 9:00am EST


**AMSTERDAM, Nov. 17, 2026** – Mastervolt®, a global leader in best-in-class high-performance power solutions, today announced a new chapter in its evolution with the launch of two new products, a refreshed brand identity, and a redesigned website. Together, these milestones reinforce Mastervolt's commitment to delivering innovative, energy solutions designed to meet the growing demands of electrification, integration, and digital connectivity.


As Mastervolt celebrates its 35th anniversary, the company continues to build on a legacy of engineering excellence and power expertise that has earned the trust of marine and mobile customers worldwide. As onboard systems become increasingly sophisticated and interconnected, Mastervolt is evolving to provide smarter, more seamless solutions that simplify energy management while delivering greater control, monitoring, and system integration.


“This marks an exciting new chapter for Mastervolt," said Ton De Winter, President, Power Solutions at Navico Group. "Our refreshed brand reflects the evolution of our business and our vision for the future of energy management. The launch of our new website and innovative new products demonstrates that vision in action, reinforcing our commitment to delivering integrated solutions that connect power, control, and automation while continuing to provide the performance and dependability customers have trusted for decades."


**New Products Bring the Vision to Life**


**MLI Max 48/5400**


The MLI Max 48/5400 is a purpose-built 48V lithium battery engineered to deliver greater usable power, simplified installation and reliable performance in demanding environments. Its integrated design combines advanced system safety, seamless networking, and all-weather durability in a streamlined, single-unit solution for 48V power systems.


Enhanced safety and upgraded performance were key design priorities in the development of the MLI Max Series. An integrated e-Switch with inrush current limiting and a secondary safety disconnect provide multiple layers of internal protection, eliminating the need for bulky external switching components. At the same time, an engineered depth of discharge greater than 90% delivers more usable energy, allowing users to maximize battery capacity without compromising cell longevity or long-term battery health.


An advanced internal Battery Management System (BMS) continuously monitors cell health and actively redistributes energy across the module, maximizing real-time efficiency while safeguarding long-term pack health. Native CZone®, NMEA 2000® and MasterBus integration provide instant monitoring, while coordinated control enables multi-battery banks to operate seamlessly as a single system.


Engineered for the harsh conditions commonly encountered in both marine and mobile applications, the MLI Max Series delivers dependable performance in a wide range of operating environments. A sealed IP67-rated enclosure protects against dust and water immersion, while an integrated internal heater enables safe charging in sub-zero climates. Accessible connections, integrated cable management and an externally accessible Class T fuse compartment help speed commissioning and support a safe, clean installation. ****


**CombiMaster 48/5000-70 (230V)**


The CombiMaster range is expanding with the introduction of the new 230V CombiMaster 48/5000-70, delivering high-capacity power conversion for demanding marine, mobile, and industrial applications. Additional 230V models, including 3500W and 4500W variants, are planned for release in 2027, further broadening the range to meet a wider variety of installation requirements. Engineered for uncompromised thermal performance, the CombiMaster delivers 100% of its rated continuous power in ambient temperatures up to 40°C without derating. Its intelligent Power Assist functionality automatically supplements limited shore power or generator capacity with battery power during peak demand, helping prevent nuisance breaker trips and ensuring reliable operation when it matters most.


Native MasterBus, CZone®, and NMEA 2000® integration enables unified system communication, monitoring and control without additional interfaces. Support for parallel and three-phase configurations allows integrators to scale AC power or configure multi-phase system architectures to meet a range of installation requirements.


"These new products exemplify the direction of the Mastervolt brand," added De Winter. "They reflect our ongoing investment in innovation and our commitment to helping customers navigate an increasingly connected and electrified future."


As part of the transformation, Mastervolt has also launched a redesigned[website](https://www.mastervolt.com/) that delivers an improved customer experience. Featuring intuitive navigation, enhanced product information and expanded technical resources, the new digital platform makes it easier for customers, partners, and installers to research products, explore complete system solutions and access the information they need. The platform has been designed to support future growth while enabling richer content, enhanced functionality and more streamlined interactions.


The refreshed brand identity and new products will be on display at METSTRADE in Amsterdam, November 17-19.


For more information about Mastervolt and its portfolio of power solutions, visit[www.mastervolt.com](http://www.mastervolt.com/) .


*###*


**About Mastervolt**


Mastervolt is part of Navico Group, a division of Brunswick Corporation (NYSE: BC) and is a leading provider of dynamic, best-in-class power solutions for energy storage, conversion, charging, and control. Trusted worldwide across marine, mobile, and industrial applications, Mastervolt delivers integrated power solutions designed to work together as a complete energy ecosystem, helping customers simplify energy management and optimize onboard power systems. For more information about Mastervolt, visit https://www.mastervolt.com/.


**About Navico Group**


A division of Brunswick Corporation (NYSE: BC), Navico Group is the world’s leading supplier of integrated systems and products to industries ranging from marine to recreational vehicle and beyond. The Navico Group portfolio is comprised of industry-leading brands in power management, digital control & monitoring, networked devices, and marine electronics. Some of the many brands that make up Navico Group include: Ancor, Attwood, B&G, BEP, Blue Sea Systems, C-Map, CZone, Lenco, Lowrance, Marinco, Mastervolt, Progressive Industries, ProMariner, Simrad, and Whale.
